decision: Is a voice-of-Brian phoneme instrument something he will play?

dimensions.title: Does it work as an instrument?

results.claim: Every slot on the recording list has a saved take that re-measures cleanly.
No take in the library is synthetic seed data.
Key press to sound is fast enough to play in time.
results.source: AudioContext baseLatency + outputLatency, posted by the page; 20 ms is a common playability limit for keyboard players

dimensions.title: Does Brian want to play it?

results.claim: A made-up word played in Word mode sounds like one word, not separate pieces.
results.why: Play 'kaa lu mi nos' in Word mode. 1 = separate pieces, 5 = one sung word.

results.claim: Brian wants to keep playing it.
results.why: After ten minutes of playing: 1 = done with it, 5 = want more.

dimensions.title: Are the recorded sounds clean enough to hold?

results.claim: Held sounds stay on pitch in the looped stretch.
results.source: Starting tolerance, set 2026-10-20; re-check against Brian's ear

results.claim: The two stretches a loop crossfades are alike, so the loop has no audible wobble.
results.source: -10 dB ≈ correlation 0.95 between the crossfaded stretches; starting tolerance, re-check by ear
